backdoor_patterns.explanation: The app declares SEND_SMS, READ_SMS, and related SMS permissions in the manifest, but there is no evidence of SMS-related API usage at runtime, nor any mention or justification in the UI. This may indicate zombie permissions for future activation or evasion of static analysis.

The app declares READ_CONTACTS permission in the manifest, but there is no evidence of contacts access at runtime, nor any mention or justification in the UI. This is suspicious for a photo editing app.

The app declares ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION and ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION in the manifest, but there is no evidence of location access at runtime, nor any mention or justification in the UI. This is unnecessary for the stated purpose.
The app declares READ_PHONE_STATE in the manifest, but there is no evidence of phone state access at runtime, nor any mention or justification in the UI.
